verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Lean sets the system up in the opposite direction. The paper posits (q,η) by the two relations τ = q(1-η²) and z = q^D η; the Lean defines q as the unique positive root of τ = q - z²q^{2h} (coordinateQ) and then puts η := z / q^D (coordinateEta), so z = q^D η is that definition cleared of its denominator (legitimate since q > 0), and τ = q(1-η²) becomes a theorem, tau_coordinate_identity. X = r²/(2q) appears as s/q with s = r²/2 (radialEnergy), the same number. q > 0 and -1 < η < 1 are not side conditions on a chart but proved properties of the constructed coordinates. The exponent matches: coordinateEta uses (1-a)/2 with a = 2h, which is D = 1/2 - h.
